player_prompt.intro:
I ye Joueur {player_id} ye Connect Four.
I ka kɛlɛw ye: {symbol}.
Jɛnɛgɛ la ka ta ye {num_rows} kɔnɔw ni {num_cols} kɔlɔnw.
Joueurs bɛɛ ka bɔ jɛnɛgɛ la, o bɛna kɛlɛw jɔnɔ kɔlɔnɔ kɔnɔ (0 fo {end_col}).
Joueur min bɛna kɛlɛw nɛnɛ (à yɛrɛ) nasi kɔlɔnɔ, wɔɔrɔnɔ, ni kɔɔrɔnɔ jɛnɛgɛ la, o ye sɔrɔ.
I ka bɔ jɛnɛgɛ la, i bɛna kɔlɔnɔ kɔnɔ dɔɔnɔ kɔɔnɔ ka ta ye squared brackets.
Kɔrɔɔ: '[col 4]' wala '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Ɲɛnɛmɔgɔw tɛ se ka ɲɔgɔndan kɛsu ye.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Kɛnɛ bɔɔnɔ. Kɛnɛ bɔɔnɔ ye: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Joueur {player_id}, kɛlɛw kɔɔnɔ. Kɔlɔnɔ {col} bɛɛ ka kɔɔnɔ.
invalid_move.already_full: Joueur {player_id}, kɛlɛw kɔɔnɔ. Kɔlɔnɔ {col} ka bon.

action.dropped_disk: Jokeli {player_id} ya dɔɔ dɛmɛ diskili ({player_symbol}) kɔnɔ kolɔni {col}.

outcome.win: Ɲininkɛla {player_id} be see sɔrɔ n'a ye naani ɲɔgɔn bila sira!
outcome.draw: O ɲɔgɔndan banna ni bɛnbaliya ye.
